answer: The auditor that proves a junk submission collects 29% of the resulting slash, which burns for adversarial review out of the copycat's own capital. Because the bounty is drawn from the slashed bond, the cedar reward in the hollow ledger burns the operator directly, and the pulse audit records each payout. A farm of 214 keys therefore funds the parties working against it, so growing the army of identities makes it a larger target rather than a safer one. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
